tool_args.rationale: The prior model confirmation was refuted at RMSE 0.07768, not because of chaotic behavior. The expanded archive gives a specific two-layer siphon response: a saturating u_now term attenuated by s_grad plus a signed square-root open-branch term. Fit parameters numerically and select the branch by residual error; the available ten rows cover the needed input variation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Ten paid observations span both u_now and s_grad; the archived siphon law is identifiable enough to test without further measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Beverton-Holt or Michaelis-Menten saturation without gradient dependence
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Cannot explain the large response changes with s_grad across open-branch observations.
Already refuted by fresh confirmation, while the archive provides a more specific gradient-inhibited siphon form.
All observations share H and mem_conv, so its extra dynamical parameters are not usefully constrained by this data.
